definitions.short: properly, to start up suddenly , i.e. (by implication) to hasten away , to fear
definitions.full: H2648. chaphaz [ חָפַז ] verb be in trepidation, hurry, or alarm (Arabic hasten, incite, urge ); — Qal Imperfect יַחְמּוֺז Job 40:23 ; תַּחְמְּזוּ Deut 20:3 ; Infinitive construct suffix בְּחָפְזִי Psalm 31:28; Psa 116:11 ; בְּחָמְּזָהּ 2Sam 4:4 ; בְּחָפְזָם 2Kin 7:15 Qr (Kt הֵחָֽפְזֵם ); — 1 be in a hurry or alarm , of hurried flight 2Sam 4:4 ; 2Kin 7:15 ; Infinitive with ב = noun, in my alarm Psa 31:23 ; 116:11 ; be alarmed Deut 20:3 (|| תיראו ), Job 40:23 (of hippopotamus) Niph`al Perfect נֶחְמָּ֑זוּ Psa 48:6 (|| נִבְהֲלוּ ) hurry away in alarm ; so Imperfect יֵחָפֵז֑וּן 104:7 (|| יְּנוּסוּן ); Infinitive הֵחָֽפְזֵם 2Kin 7:15 Kt see above; Participle נֶחְמָּז 1Sam 23:26 hurried נ דוד ׳ויהי ללבת and David became hurried to go .
